findings.summary: N0067 eul2m_c calls the translated routine into an uninitialized local matrix, then transposes it even on an early toolkit error. Caller-initialized output cannot initialize the private matrix.
findings.repair: Use the same external eul2m_ implementation with initialized output, the public chkin/chkout trace frame, and row-major transposition only after success. Known-valid oracle comparisons can also call the public wrapper. Structural checks require the exact external symbol and trace. Error probes use actual SPICELIB diagnostics with initialized storage.

routines.semantics: Return the row-major rotation matrix for a scalar-first SPICE quaternion. A zero quaternion yields identity. Ordinary q, −q and safe nonzero multiples describe the same rotation. N0067 forms unscaled products and norms, so finite extreme magnitudes can produce identity or NaN entries. Preserve every raw double from the scientific result.

Distinguish scalar-first ordering and each independent axis.
Distinguish signs and row-major layout of non-symmetric matrices.
Observe underflow to identity, normal tiny scale, and the transition to infinite squared length with finite products.
